$meta.name: Views across records (theory-shaped collection)
$meta.the_question: When can views recorded in SEPARATE records (methods, campaigns, sites, times) be merged into one world, allowing each record to deviate by a budget eps fixed in advance from outside the data (biology, instrument specs)? Simultaneous views always glue; the question has content only when the context hypergraph of records has a loop.

streams.S0_underlying: eps*(data) = least per-record deviation admitting one common joint; acyclic vs cyclic context hypergraphs; finite-sample tests under dependence.
streams.S1_ecology_multimethod: Binary presence, >=3 survey methods whose species sets overlap round a loop (camera/eDNA/transect). ACTIVE (user's favourite domain). Next = find a dataset with that loop design.
streams.S2_time_series_embeddings: Multiple time series from separate campaigns: linear/Gaussian = PSD of assembled cross-spectral matrix per frequency (loop phase = closure phase); nonlinear = one attractor across separately recorded multivariate embeddings (Deyle-Sugihara, multiview). ACTIVE: scout running 2026-11-05.
streams.S3_neuro: Seizure EEG (CHB-MIT chb01). RESTED 2026-11-05: both gates null/redundant; simultaneous record so eps*=0 by construction except via chosen delays.

$meta.lesson_2026-11-05: A loop twist needs (i) strong within-record ties (d near 0 or 1) AND (ii) ties that differ across records. Plankton fails (i); lake physics meets (i), shares physics so (ii) is weak; the loop then flags only the odd lake (Allequash) at the noise edge.

objects.name: Records as contexts
objects.def: Each record k observes a variable set S_k jointly and yields a law P_k on S_k. The records' S_k form the context hypergraph.

objects.name: Heterogeneity budget eps*
objects.def: eps* = min over joint Q of max_k TV(Q|S_k, P_k) (an LP). Compared against eps_cal fixed in advance.

objects.name: Loop (closure) phase
objects.def: Phi(w) = phi_AB(w)+phi_BC(w)+phi_CA(w) from pairwise cross-spectra of separate campaigns.

theorems.statement: Views computed from one simultaneous record always glue (eps* = 0): the record's empirical law is a common joint.
theorems.status: hand-verified (trivial); confirmed in data (eps_sim = 0 in every window, chb01)

theorems.statement: Acyclic context hypergraph: pairwise-consistent margins always admit a joint. Hence two-dataset integration has no model-free test.
Binary L-cycle: eps* = V/L, V = max violation of the cycle inequalities on disagreement rates.
theorems.status: lower bound hand-proved (ours); upper bound OWNED (Dzhafarov-Kujala-Cervantes 2020 Thm 15 + eq 56, p->inf), reversal check pending
hand-proved + LP-checked; special case of DKC 2020

theorems.statement: Sign-binarised jointly Gaussian pairs: triangle eps* > 0 iff the 3x3 correlation matrix [cos theta] is not PSD (Sheppard d = theta/pi + spherical triangle inequalities).
Gaussian stationary, equal coherences c, loop phase Phi: one joint process iff cos Phi >= (3c^2-1)/(2c^3) (c=0.8 -> 26 deg; c=0.95 -> 5.3 deg; c<=0.5 always).
theorems.status: hand + numerically checked; matrix math OWNED (Barrett-Johnson-Loewy 1996 cycle completability); use on separate-campaign spectra: aeroacoustics nearest (unread past abstract)

theorems.statement: Per-instrument time offsets s_i shift phi_ij by w(s_i - s_j) and cancel in the loop phase: the test is invariant to per-instrument delays.
theorems.status: hand (elementary); same as interferometric closure phase (Jennison 1958)

theorems.statement: With a common clock, a loop's closure phase at a deterministic seasonal frequency equals the sum of visible single-variable phase differences across records: it carries no invisible information. Closure phase is informative only for records without a common clock.
No false positives + independent per-species detection + each shared species reported at equal rates across methods => reports admit one classical world (eps* = 0); any true world, any hypergraph.

'Synchrony from static pairwise drivers only' and 'the classical triangle network' are the same mDAG marginal model (three independent pairwise latent sources); a single regional driver imposes no constraint. Network causal-compatibility tools (Steudel-Ay, inflation, Rosset-Gisin-Wolfe) apply unchanged.
theorems.status: identity of definitions (hand); owners Fritz 2012, Evans 2016 (mDAGs)

theorems.statement: Unrolled in time, interaction (dispersal) creates common ancestors: pond B at t-1 is a common cause of A_t and C_t. So consensus by interaction = no centre in SPACE but a centre in TIME (shared history). 'No centre' splits three ways: regional driver (space) / shared history (time) / static pairwise sources (neither; capped, ~0.56 for binary sources). A same-time Steudel-Ay violation cannot distinguish the first two; lag structure along dispersal paths can.
theorems.status: hand, 2026-11-05 (refines the earlier 'interactions reach consensus without a centre')

theorems.statement: With a continuous candidate cue, 'the cue is the ONLY common cause' is not testable model-free at small n: coarse strata leave within-stratum cue variation (still common, so violations can persist under H0); fine strata leave too few years. Existence of a common cause is model-free; attribution needs an assumption (e.g. additive cue effect) or much more data.

For ANY pairwise-only world (independent pair-sources, arbitrary site responses, local noise), the Pearson correlation matrix is pairwise-feasible: exists t_ij>0 with r_ij^2 <= t_ij t_ji and sum_j t_ij <= 1 for all i. V_G = min_w max_i sum_j t_ij - 1 <= 0. Three equal correlations: r <= 1/2.
theorems.status: OWNED: Kela-von Prillwitz-Aberg-Chaves-Gross 2020 IEEE TIT Prop. 1 (shelved); proof independently checked (correct with minor fixes); closed form V_G = Perron root of |R-I| minus 1

conjectures.statement: Real multi-method survey data with a loop design either sit inside a biology-calibrated eps ball (expected) or reveal a missed detection/disturbance channel.
conjectures.status: open; NOT FOUND in ecology (Goldstein et al. 2026 call model-free concordance tests future work)

conjectures.statement: Separately recorded environmental time series closing a loop can fail the per-frequency PSD test beyond sampling error.
conjectures.status: open; scout running; 2026-11-05: needs records WITHOUT a common clock (T-shared-clock) - paleo, unsynchronised instruments

conjectures.statement: Nonlinear version: is there a usable test that separately recorded multivariate delay embeddings are charts of one attractor (beyond pairwise CCM)?
A finite-sample eps*-test valid for autocorrelated / spatially dependent data.

A detection-aware gluing test (identify each method's channel from repeat visits, as in occupancy models, invert it, then test eps*) is not covered by occupancy models (assume one world) or by CbD (visible check only guards thinning).

When views cohere, is the coherence held by a centre (common driver) or by local relations (interactions, no centre)? Snapshot views never decide: whenever any world fits, a pairwise max-entropy world (relations only) also fits, and for Gaussian data with equal pairwise correlations both stories give the same law. Deciding needs the driver measured, time order (propagation lags), distance/connectivity structure, or intervention.
conjectures.status: owned empirically as spatial synchrony: Moran effect vs dispersal; reasoning hand, 2026-11-05
conjectures.update_2026-11-05: Owned map: centre_vs_relations_owned_map.md. Owners: Steudel-Ay (I_c>0 forces a common ancestor of >c variables; X=Y=Z needs a centre), triangle-network theory (Fritz 2012; Wolfe-Spekkens-Fritz inflation; Navascues-Wolfe; Rosset-Gisin-Wolfe: classical triangle set closed semialgebraic; Renou et al.), Gacs-Korner/Wyner common information, Angluin 1980 (coverings block leader election). Hand observation (unverified): relations-as-INTERACTIONS (pairwise MRF closure) reach perfect consensus X=Y=Z, relations-as-SOURCES (triangle) cannot - the two notions of 'no centre' split on the boundary. Seams: (A) triangle vs pairwise-MRF on binary alphabets incl. boundary; (B) finitely additive / Omega-free version (Markov-category work assumes standard Borel); (C) time order vs snapshot on loops (cyclic SCMs).

examples.text: Four friends, 3 pairs always agree, 1 always disagrees: eps* = 1/4 (move d to (1/4,1/4,1/4,3/4)).
Frogs-herons (camera), herons-fish (eDNA), fish-frogs (transect): triangle test by hand from three disagreement rates.
Three rivers, three campaigns, coherence 0.8 each: loop phase must be within 26 deg.
Equal detection rates, but detection positively coupled in two methods and anti-coupled in the third: eps* = 1/6 with consistent margins.
One method with p = f = 1/2 matches the perfect methods' rates but reports noise: eps* = 1/6 with consistent margins.

Triangle of pairwise streams, each good w.p. q = 1/sqrt2; a pond has frogs iff both its streams are good (margins exactly 1/2). P(all agree) = q^3 + 3q(1-q)^2 + (1-q)^3 = 0.5607 (all-frogs 0.354, all-none 0.207). Best binary-source model on a grid search (0.559 at q=0.7). Interactions (pairwise Ising) reach any P(all agree) up to 1. OWNED: equals Gisin et al. 2020's NSI bound E2 <= sqrt2-1, i.e. (3sqrt2-2)/4; quantum sources cannot exceed it.
examples.scope: binary outputs, binary sources, margins 1/2; not the symmetric noisy-GHZ family
